resolution.note: test/lane/lifecycle.test.ts walks create, edit, dep add, start, scope, stop, commit, ship, drop on real git with a captured-gh receiver and snapshots every store per verb; node --test passes; fast PASS

title: One real-git lane lifecycle suite walks every lane and task verb against every store
body:
Evidence: ADR 0029 migration step 1b; t-setr7a5 Outcome 'the lifecycle suite runs in CI'; untracked reproductions .krn/tmp/gemini/d3.test.ts, d4.test.ts, d7.test.ts, d8.test.ts.
Outcome: test/lane/lifecycle.test.ts walks one real-git lane (bare origin + clone, real krn verbs in process, no stubbed transport, no prior-lane state) through task create, edit, dep add, lane start, a scope-hook write decision, a Stop-hook decision, ship against a fake GitHub receiver built from verbatim captures, and drop, asserting every store after each verb; cases already fixed on main (dep on pending, refused start) are green; the d3/d4/d7 behaviours not yet fixed are listed in the file header with the ADR step that will add them.
Proof: node --test test/lane/lifecycle.test.ts: exit 0 in CI's test shard; the file is listed in the shard weights.
Files: test/lane/lifecycle.test.ts, test/helpers/, test/fixtures/gh/
